source.source_boundary: Manual pp201-202 allows on-mission Redundancy repair for CONTINUOUS or EXTENDABLE missions if the LRU replacement is at the system home base and spares/resources are available. If NRLRQ links cease to be functional, redundancy faults become critical and mission aborts. This candidate uses inherited BASE-01 SystemRepair and stocked LRUs, and changes the fixed three-sortie schedule to one long continuous mission.
